source: Immutable continuation01 expanded-v2, same 12 families and original 8/4 split for every comparison
timing: perf_counter seconds around complete pinned prepare_view, including validation, canonical hashes and deep copies; no file IO or import; three runs, report median. Serialization measured separately and is already also included where producer hashes output.
memory: One separate tracemalloc run per cell; additional peak Python allocation, not process RSS, excludes preloaded source corpus; memory instrumentation excluded from timing runs.
field_unit: Exact JSON atomic leaf identified by node and JSON pointer, including empty containers; native-message fields separate from normalized wrapper fields. Duplicate copies under native_node are counted only in normalized-field measure.
text_unit: Exact native literal text fields including equivalent aliases for field coverage; alias duplicates excluded from literal byte sum.
relation_unit: Explicit native parent links including unresolved external references; source-wide denominator and selected-child denominator separately. Source structure is not semantic understanding.
serialization_unit: Canonical UTF-8 JSON bytes. Syntax/key overhead excludes bytes of canonical scalar values. Bytes above literal text also include metadata and envelopes and are not called pure serialization overhead.
interpretation_limits: No tokenizer or token estimate is used. Byte and record counts are not tokens.
All measurements are deterministic source accounting plus environment-specific time/allocation observations, not model answer quality.
Field micro-averages weight larger conversations; separate family macro values keep families as the dependence unit.
Checkpoint is the existing derived path or source-array boundary view, never a generated summary or a user-declared checkpoint.
All source data are available during retrospective measurement; this is not an independent holdout or prospective next-turn evaluation.
Exact native-message and normalized-node reconstruction refer to JSON values, not original export byte serialization.
No tested view reconstructs the whole conversation wrapper or embeds available attachment binaries.
Repeated time samples are technical repeats of a family, not independent sources; runtime noise is not controlled hardware benchmarking.
Only original expanded-v2 views are measured; later preference annotation revisions do not alter these preserved measurements.
